title: Say Pabelat na Regalo ya Ag-inawat
intro: Diad gapo na awaran na too, nen say dalin et ugaw ni tan say mundo et akapeket ed inmunan panlinawa to, sakey a kamarerwa so inmalagey ed arap na Manamalsa tekep na mapaabeban apay. Sayan bagat et sinimbang ed timbangan na madibinon panangawat — tan aromog ya kulang. Say tinmumbok et aliwan istorya na panamerdona, no ag say puso ya nauupot na imon, ya angitonton ed agnauman ya gawa ya mansiansia ed amin a panaon. Saya so istorya na sakey ya say ngaran to et nagmaliw ya mipara ed sankaunaan ya graben ag-inkahustisya ya agawa.
clues: Linma ak bilang sakey ed saray sankaunaan ya anak ya nianak, ya inyanak na sakey ya ateng ya amta yon maong so istorya to.
Aminsan et angiyapay ak na bagat ed si Allah, balet ag ko itan inawat — anggaman say bagat na agik et inawat ko tekep na grasya.
Nanlamot ed pusok so imon tan sanok, tan tinaktakot kon pateyen koy bilay na mismon kakanayon ko.
Pinasakbayan ak na agik ya ontakot ed si Allah, balet ag ak inabuloyan na pride ko ya ondengel.
Diad sakey a bekta na makapataktakot a kakapuyan, ginawak so agnasabi a gawa ed mismon agik.
Kayari to, ag ko ni amta no panon kon iyamot so ginawak — anggad sakey a pinalsa ed dalin so imbaki ton mangibangat ed siak.

identity.label: Siopa ak?
options: Qabil (Cain)
Habil (Abel)
Say anak nen Propeta Nuh
Propeta Isma'il
Propeta Yusuf

trial.label: Trial/Event
options: Say pangiyapay na bagat ya impulisay, ya angitonton ed inmunan impamatey
Manggawa na atagey a tori pian makasabi ed tawen
Say pangibantak ed mandarlang ya apoy parad pananisia
Say pangibagat ed dilin anak bilang katutulok ed si Allah
Say pakaakmon na baleg a sira lapud itatakas toy obligasyon to
trial.answer: Say pangiyapay na bagat ya impulisay, ya angitonton ed inmunan impamatey

location.label: Manunan Elemento
options: Sakey ya uwak ya imbaki nen Allah pian ipanengneng so panagponpon
Sakey a baleg a delap ya amalereg ed interon totoo
Sakey a baston ya nagmaliw ya mabilay ya uleg
Sakey a kabatyan a kamelyo ya pinmaway ed sakey a palandey na bato
Sakey a makapadinayew a trono ya aawiten na maksil iran dagem
location.answer: Sakey ya uwak ya imbaki nen Allah pian ipanengneng so panagponpon

outcome.label: Pansumpalan
options: Nagmaliw ya sakey ed saray manbabawi, nabebelatan ed sankaunaan ya krimen ya agawaan
Pinerdona nen Allah tan inikdan toy andi-anggaan a Paraiso
Nitagey ed atagey a posisyon na propesiya tan kakabatan
Nilaban lapud panangasi na Dios kayari ton tinmawag manlapud kaaraleman na kabilungetan
Niiter so pakauley ed saray jinn, dagem, tan dayat
outcome.answer: Nagmaliw ya sakey ed saray manbabawi, nabebelatan ed sankaunaan ya krimen ya agawaan

arabic: فَطَوَّعَتْ لَهُۥ نَفْسُهُۥ قَتْلَ أَخِيهِ فَقَتَلَهُۥ فَأَصْبَحَ مِنَ ٱلْخَـٰسِرِينَ
verse: And his soul permitted to him the murder of his brother, so he killed him and became among the losers. (5:30)
